items.title: Netlify Server
items.source_text: Netlify Server Run WebSockets, multiplayer apps, and long-running agents Netlify Server gives your app a backend that stays alive while people are using it. Build realtime experiences, multiplayer games, and AI agents that need time to finish. Describe what you want and an agent builds it, or bring your Express, Fastify, Hono, or Koa code.
